name: entropydata-dbt-demo-builder
description: Demo-grade builder for Trino dbt data products on Stackable with Entropy Data.

interface.shortDescription: Demo builder for Trino dbt data products on Stackable.
interface.longDescription: Streamlined demo plugin for the Stackable + Entropy Data demo. Scaffolds a data product folder (ODPS, output-port ODCS, Trino dbt project) under dags/dataproducts/<id>/, generates the output-port models from the ODCS contract, and runs it through the generic Airflow DAG (publish to Entropy Data, dbt-ol build with OpenLineage, datacontract test) or locally. Three skills: dataproduct-bootstrap, dataproduct-implement, and datacontract-test.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap a new data product that reads from tpch-analytics.
